topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I can't believe this. I just opened the attic for the first time since moving in, thinking maybe it could be a place for storage, a bit of extra space. But no, it’s like a time capsule of someone else’s life. Old photographs, torn furniture, boxes and boxes of stuff. I don’t know what to do. I didn’t sign up for this. We just wanted a fresh start, a clean slate. Now, it feels like I’m wading through a stranger’s past. I don’t even know where to begin. Do I keep it, sell it, donate, throw it out? Every box seems to weigh a ton. I just want this house to feel like ours.
